title: Billing Efficiency chart draws one line per advisor and nothing else
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two service advisors have invoiced work with clocked time this month in this location.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: Billing Efficiency (This Month) > View details: the Advisor Analysis table lists at least two advisors. If not, create an invoice with clocked time for each advisor: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). Then repeat with a second customer and, in the work order's left panel, a different Service Advisor.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Billing Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months.
  3. Click View details on the Billing Efficiency tile.
  4. Count the names in the chart's legend.
  5. Count the distinct coloured lines drawn on the chart.
  6. Read the axes on the left and right of the chart.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The legend lists every advisor with billing in the range (e.g. 7 names) and the chart draws exactly one line per advisor (e.g. 7 lines), each in its legend colour.
  • There is no line for ELR and no second axis for dollars: there is one left-hand percentage axis and no right-hand axis.
  • There is no shop-average, total or other reference line: the number of lines equals the number of advisors in the legend.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 9. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 05_Billing_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R4: “The Billing Efficiency chart draws one billing-efficiency line per advisor.”
  • S9-R6: “The Billing Efficiency chart does not draw ELR as its own line or axis.”
  • S9-R7: “A chart draws only the lines its own story defines: one line per selected technician on the technician charts, and one line per advisor on the Billing Efficiency chart (S9-R4). It draws no shop-average line, no aggregate line and no other reference line behind or alongside them. Any additional drawn series is a defect.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
